note: Golden fixture cho TruyenTV (www.tvtruyen.space, site VN SSR tieng Viet). Truyen mau 1: Tu Hai Nhi Bat Dau Nhap Dao (Dich) — Co Hi, Dang ra, ~1.250 chuong (25 trang muc luc x 50; so chuong tang dan, khong khang dinh tuyet doi), the loai Dong Phuong/He Thong/Huyen Huyen/Nhe Nhang; ch.1 mo dau 'Dau dau du doi!...' (nhan vat Ly Hao); ch.98 mo dau 'Danh co cung vay.'; 8 binh luan (QQ Comment Service, model comics, data-id 4000009985). Truyen mau 2 (Hoan thanh): Gio ben canh le thoi buot, tuyet kho tan — trang thai 'Full', 11 chuong; ch.1 72 doan, ket 'Ben ngoai dot nhien vang len tieng go cua.'. Site da chuyen domain tvtruyen.cc -> www.tvtruyen.space (301, kiem chung 2026-11-13); tvtruyen.vip cung 301 ve .space; tvtruyen.com 403; .net/.org/.xyz/.me chet. Tim kiem slug-hoa tu khoa co dau. JSON-LD tren trang chi tiet khong parse duoc (description chua xuong dong tho) nen detail.js doc DOM. Chuong doc DU khong can dang nhap, da doi chieu dung truyen goc. Port tu kychi truyentv v7 (fork tren dia, src doc duoc), viet lai theo quy tac nha (bo UA mobile cung, dung pacedFetch + safeFirst; bo tab VIP + tab nhac bat VPN cua base).
